How much the Top 20 carry

Share of all poll weight in the race averages.

Rank and grade: Silver Bulletin pollster ratings (Jan 2026); firms it doesn't rate use FiveThirtyEight's final ratings rescaled. House effect: how far a firm's polls ran from other firms' in the same races, after shrinkage (positive = more Democratic). Weight: the multiplier every one of its polls receives before recency and sample size.
